Plugin.Name: Vast.ai Monitor
Plugin.Overview:
Adds a dashboard tile for your Vast.ai host machines.
Shows each machine's rental state (on-demand, interruptible, reserved, listed, unlisted or offline), live hourly earnings and projected daily income, GPU model and VRAM, real time GPU temperature with colour thresholds, and host reliability score. An expandable details row adds CPU, RAM, storage and network bandwidth. A summary line shows combined earnings across the fleet and your account balance.
Responses are cached server side with a configurable TTL so several open dashboard tabs do not each hit the Vast.ai API, and the tile falls back to the last good response and labels it clearly when the API is unreachable.
Requires a Vast.ai account and an API key, which is stored on the flash drive readable only by root and is scrubbed when the plugin is uninstalled.
